name: Tourmaline Phial
summary: At the Pools of Arlithrien, the Tourmaline Phial gathers blessed moonwell water for Teldrassil's rituals.

sections.title: Vessel of Arlithrien
sections.body: Corithras Moonrage gives the Tourmaline Phial to travelers for rituals that tend the World Tree. Druids in Dolanaar use gemstone vials to collect pure moonwell water across Teldrassil. This phial is meant for the moonwell beside the Pools of Arlithrien, southeast of the road to Darnassus, where hostile Gnarlpine furbolgs are growing more troublesome.

faq.q: What is the Tourmaline Phial used for?
faq.answer: The Tourmaline Phial collects sacred water from the moonwell at the Pools of Arlithrien. Once filled, you return it to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar for the Crown of the Earth rituals.

aliases: where do i get tourmaline phial
faq.answer: Corithras Moonrage, a night elf druid in Dolanaar, gives travelers the empty phial.

faq.q: Where is the moonwell for this phial?
faq.answer: The moonwell lies beside the Pools of Arlithrien, southeast of the main gateway to Darnassus.

angles.text: As a druid, you carry a gemstone phial to gather moonwell water, a ceremonial duty as you learn to tend Teldrassil's fragile ecosystem.
As a night elf, you know moonwell water reflects your people's reliance on Elune's grace and druidic vigilance as Teldrassil struggles against corruption.
